column1: # best-config-linux-local.tsv — the SINGLE UNIFORM forst-rs config for the
# BARE-METAL (non-docker) Linux-local runner (run-linux-local-forstrs.sh).
# ★★ UNIFORM CONFIG (2026-06-17, PMC-1 — user directive). PER-QUERY CONFIG IS
# FORBIDDEN. There is exactly ONE config row (`*`) and run-linux-local-forstrs.sh
# applies it to EVERY NexMark query identically (the same apply_uniform pattern as
# the docker harness's run-best.sh). The old per-query split (q9 bloom/hot-CF, q11/
# q12/q16/q17/q18 KV-sep OFF, q7/q20 persistent-probe, q3/q8 adaptive-S2, etc.) has
# been PURGED. KV-sep is uniformly ON; the engine adapts to the query SHAPE at
# runtime (see the docker best-config.tsv "ENGINE AUTO-SELECTS" notes) — there are
# no per-query branches in this file or in run-linux-local-forstrs.sh.
# This row MIRRORS the docker harness's uniform `*` row (tools/nexmark-local/
# configs/best-config.tsv): same KV-sep + levers + mem-manager + lz4. It is the
# SAME engine config; only the RUNNER mechanism differs (bare-metal / non-docker,
# kept deliberately as this entrypoint's distinct mechanism).
# TOPOLOGY (uniform, every query): the bare-metal Linux-local invariant is the
# 8c/32g TM budget realized as 2 TaskManagers x 4c/16g, parallelism 8, 4 task slots
# per TM, TOPO=split. This is the bare-metal runner's standing topology intent and
# is applied identically to every query (NOT a per-query difference). The runner
# pins SPLIT_TM_CPUS=4 / SPLIT_TM_MEM=16g / FRS_FLINK_PARALLELISM=8 / FRS_TM_SLOTS=4
# for all queries.
#   NOTE on parallelism vs the docker harness: the docker run-best.sh uses
#   parallelism=4 (slot-skew fixed via taskmanager.load-balance.mode=SLOTS). The
#   bare-metal runner here keeps its long-standing parallelism=8 / 4-slots-per-TM
#   envelope so its previously-measured numbers stay comparable. That is a RUNNER
#   topology choice (uniform across all queries), NOT a per-query config knob.
# Conservative bare-metal-local defaults still applied by the runner for EVERY
# query (these are uniform, not per-query): FRS_TM_JEMALLOC=1 (Linux OOM amplifier
# — =0 strictly worse, the never-OOM manager force-enables it anyway),
# FRS_MEM_PURGE_AT=elevated (proactive build-peak jemalloc purge; `high` on a box
# with ample headroom), FRS_IO_URING=1, FRS_SCAN_OPEN_FANOUT=1,
# FRS_SCAN_COLD_PRIME=1, FRS_RS_READ_IO_PARALLELISM=3, FRS_VLOG_COMPRESSION=inherit.
# KNOB NAMES verified against the engine (crates/forst-rs-engine/src/db.rs):
#   FRS_KV_SEPARATION       1|true => ON (default OFF)
#   FRS_KV_MIN_BLOB_SIZE    bytes, default 256, floor 22
#   FRS_TRIVIAL_MOVE        1|true => ON (default OFF)
#   FRS_RS_S2_PINNED        1|true => ON (default OFF)
#   FRS_VLOG_COALESCE_DEREF 1|true => ON (default OFF)
#   FRS_VLOG_POINT_DEREF    UNSET => auto-follows KV-sep (windowed point-RMW)
#   FRS_VLOG_READER_CACHE_CAP   handle cap, default 2048
#   FRS_VLOG_RESIDENT_BUDGET_MB resident vlog byte budget
#   FRS_KV_ADAPTIVE_PRESSURE 1 => back off separation under budget
#   FRS_MEM_MANAGER         1 => arm the never-OOM controller
#   FRS_TM_JEMALLOC         1 => eager-decay jemalloc over the TM JVM (Linux OOM
#                           amplifier; =0 strictly worse; mgr force-enables it)
#   FRS_MEM_PURGE_AT        critical|high|elevated (default elevated when armed)
#   FRS_SST_COMPRESSION     none|lz4|zstd (engine default + ForSt match = lz4)
# EXCLUDED FROM THE UNIFORM DEFAULT (documented — NOT folded into one config, same
# rationale as the docker best-config.tsv): FRS_RS_EXECUTOR=routing-adaptive/inline,
# FRS_S2_FANOUT_MIN, FRS_RS_PROBE_BLOOM_PRUNE, FRS_RS_LEVELED_HOT_CF,
# FRS_PERSISTENT_PROBE_ITER, FRS_RS_MERGE_RMW, FRS_TIMER_INDEX_MAX,
# FRS_DISABLE_MAPSTATE_CACHE — these were the per-query experimental levers; none
# was A/B-confirmed uniformly beneficial-or-neutral across query shapes. The
# uniform config keeps only the levers proven beneficial-or-neutral across shapes
# (KV-sep + coalesce + auto point-deref + the vlog resident bounds + mem-manager).
# q6 remains UNSUPPORTED (Flink SQL submission fails) and is excluded from totals
# in both runners — that is a query-availability fact, not a per-query config.
# COLUMNS (tab-separated) — mirrors the docker best-config.tsv schema:
#   query  KV_SEPARATION  KV_MIN_BLOB_SIZE  TRIVIAL_MOVE  S2_PINNED  VLOG_COALESCE_DEREF  SST_COMPRESSION  MEM_MANAGER  note
#   query "*" = the UNIFORM config; run-linux-local-forstrs.sh applies this row to EVERY query.

column9: UNIFORM config for ALL queries (bare-metal Linux-local runner). Mirrors the docker harness `*` row. KV-sep ON; FRS_VLOG_POINT_DEREF left UNSET so it auto-follows KV-sep (windowed point-RMW q11/q17 take exact-size point deref; coalesceable joins q4/q7/q19/q20 take get_coalesced). FRS_MEM_MANAGER=1 never-OOM controller (un-throttled on the >=40 GiB box). TOPO=split, bare-metal 8c/32g as 2x4c/16g, parallelism 8, 4 slots/TM. Vlog resident bounds (reader_cap 2048, budget 256m, adaptive pressure) keep the engine native bounded. NO per-query differences.
